subject.title: [Feature]: GitHub Copilot provider cannot reach GitHub Enterprise data-residency (*.ghe.com) tenants

question: Should the bundled github-copilot provider accept allowlisted GitHub Enterprise data-residency tenant routing through device-enterprise, COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN, and githubDomain config?
rationale: The issue is narrower than a new provider because OpenClaw already bundles github-copilot, but the requested fix changes provider setup, credential routing, token destinations, cache ownership, and public setup surface.

options.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
options.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for github-copilot to handle public github.com and single-label *.ghe.com tenant hosts.

options.title: Move GHE routing out of core
options.body: Reject tenant routing in the bundled provider and require a separate plugin or ClawHub package for enterprise-specific behavior.

options.title: Require a generic tenant-host contract first
options.body: Pause the linked PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth tenant-host API instead of provider-specific config and SDK exports.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Review and harden the linked PR as the supported path for github-copilot to handle public github.com and single-label *.ghe.com tenant hosts.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is assigned to the linked implementation PR and has already provided the maintainer-lane direction comment for this exact boundary.
